description:
As a result of being chased by a stalker, Ji Yoon asks a woman he doesn't know to pretend to be his girlfriend. However, the woman thinks Ji Yoon is the boyfriend she hired to accompany her on her birthday. Ji Yoon, who is thirsty for love, dates many women to satisfy his desires. Will Ji Yoon be able to find her true love?

**Original Novel:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=10195995), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/55370532)
